executionContract.nextState: Use the actual prior validated response. Apply confirmed executable actions only to an explicitly labelled in-memory synthetic state; never substitute an expected result. Record simulated receipts, not client or server persistence.
executionContract.proposals: Keep proposals pending and separate from saved synthetic events until explicit approval. Do not silently inject unapproved blocks as saved calendar context.
executionContract.history: Append actual user messages and actual assistant replies. Do not write fabricated success confirmations.
executionContract.runnerCompatibility: runRemoteBenchmark(cases) is independent-case execution and does not maintain conversational state. Running six static fixtures is not evidence for this sequence. Use a stateful conversation harness or the real native client with observed receipts.
